	GPU0	GPU1	GPU2	GPU3	NIC0	NIC1	NIC2	NIC3	CPU Affinity	NUMA Affinity	GPU NUMA ID
GPU0	 X 	NV18	NV18	NV18	PIX	NODE	SYS	SYS	0-31,64-95	0		N/A
GPU1	NV18	 X 	NV18	NV18	NODE	PIX	SYS	SYS	0-31,64-95	0		N/A
GPU2	NV18	NV18	 X 	NV18	SYS	SYS	SYS	PXB	32-63,96-127	1		N/A
GPU3	NV18	NV18	NV18	 X 	SYS	SYS	SYS	PIX	32-63,96-127	1		N/A
NIC0	PIX	NODE	SYS	SYS	 X 	NODE	NODE	SYS
NIC1	NODE	PIX	SYS	SYS	NODE	 X 	NODE	SYS
NIC2	SYS	SYS	SYS	SYS	NODE	NODE	 X 	SYS
NIC3	SYS	SYS	PXB	PIX	SYS	SYS	SYS	 X 

Legend:

  X    = Self
  SYS  = Connection traversing PCIe as well as the SMP interconnect between NUMA nodes (e.g., QPI/UPI)
  NODE = Connection traversing PCIe as well as the interconnect between PCIe Host Bridges within a NUMA node
  PIX  = Connection traversing at most a single PCIe bridge
  NV#  = Connection traversing a bonded set of # NVLinks

NIC Legend:

  NIC0: mlx5_0
  NIC1: mlx5_1
  NIC2: mlx5_2
  NIC3: mlx5_3
